name: Skip Pass
idea: When the zone slides over to the ball, throw a long pass over it to the open shooter on the other side.
why: A zone moves together toward the ball, so the far side of the court gets empty. A skip pass jumps over everyone to that side, and the zone has a long way to run to catch up.
tryit: Use two hands and step into the pass so it's strong enough to go all the way across. Shooter on the far side: stay wide, hands ready.

frames.say: Red is playing a *2-3 zone*. Each defender guards an area by the basket or up top.
{1} passes to {2}. The whole zone slides over toward the ball.
{2} dribbles toward the corner, and the zone keeps sliding to stop {2}. Look at the other side!
*Skip pass:* {2} throws the ball over the zone, all the way across to {3}.
Swish! When the zone slides to the ball, skip it to the other side.
